title: Add RAG agent templates and tool-calling quickstarts; docs site updates
author: Aisha Patel
body: Summary: Adds a set of RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) agent templates, three tool-calling quickstarts (Python, TypeScript, and Go), and corresponding docs site updates. Motivation: provide developers with copy-pasteable examples for common RAG+agents use cases and improve discoverability in the docs site. Changes include: 1) new templates under redwood-examples/rag-templates for FAQ-bot, customer-support-agent, and code-assistant; 2) three quickstarts demonstrating tool-calling (search API, knowledge base lookup, and external API invocation) across SDKs; 3) docs site pages and snippets, plus a nav entry and short tutorial. Checklist: - [x] Examples added and smoke-tested locally - [x] Docs page authored and linked in sidebar - [x] CI passing after flaky test rerun - [x] Reviewed by Docs and SDK owners - [x] Release notes draft included
commits: feat(rag): add faq-bot template and utility loaders
feat(examples): add customer-support-agent and code-assistant templates
docs: add quickstarts for tool-calling in python/ts/go
test: add example smoke tests for examples
short_diff_snippets: + template.yaml: added agent definition with tools: search, kb_lookup, http_call
+ quickstart-python.py: example using redwood-sdk-python Agent.run with tool config
+ doc: tutorial steps, expected output, and troubleshooting notes
review_comments: Daniel Kim: Nice end-to-end examples. Can we reduce the size of the sample KB to avoid long CI artifacts?
Aisha Patel: Good point - reduced KB payloads and added a lightweight smoke test that runs in CI (see test/quickstarts/smoke_test.py).
Sofia Torres: Docs wording looks good. Please add a short migration note for customers using the legacy agent templates.
Aisha Patel: Added a short migration paragraph and cross-link to migration guide.
Luca Moretti: Found a minor type error in the TypeScript quickstart imports. Requested change.
Aisha Patel: Fixed TypeScript imports and updated package.json devDeps in examples.
ci_logs_summary: CI run 1: flaky unit test (search-indexer) failed
CI run 2: rerun, all checks passed
Checks: unit-tests: pass, examples-smoke: pass, lint: pass, build-docs: pass
merge_outcome: Merged to main via squash by squadron-merge-bot after approvals and CI green
release_notes: Added RAG agent templates and tool-calling quickstarts for Python/TypeScript/Go. Docs site updated with a new quickstart page and sidebar entry. These are user-facing examples and docs only; no API or runtime changes.
notes: This PR was intentionally scoped to examples and docs to avoid runtime churn. Follow-up planned to add CI-driven end-to-end integration tests with a small in-memory vector store (ENG-8421).
